name: tinypng
title: TinyPNG
description: Compress the selected images in Finder with TinyPNG.
author: kawamataryo

commands.name: compressImagesMultipleTimes
commands.title: Compress Images Multiple Times
commands.subtitle: TinyPNG
commands.description: Compress selected images with TinyPNG multiple times.

commands.name: resizingImages
commands.title: Resizing Images
commands.subtitle: TinyPNG
commands.description: Compress and resizing selected images with TinyPNG.

preferences.title: Destination Folder Path
preferences.name: destinationFolderPath
preferences.description: Set Destination Folder path. Specify an absolute path or a relative path from the target file.

preferences.title: Resizing Destination Folder Path
preferences.name: resizeDestinationFolderPath
preferences.description: Set Destination Folder path used by the Resizing command. Specify an absolute path or a relative path from the target file.

preferences.title: Options
preferences.name: saveSingleFileNextToOriginal
preferences.label: Save Single File Next to Original
preferences.description: When saving a single image, write the result next to the original file with a suffix (e.g. "-compressed") added to its name, instead of using the Destination Folder Path.

preferences.name: overwrite
preferences.label: Overwrite Original Image File
preferences.description: Whether to overwrite the original image file.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
